description: FreshRSS integration preview, PR #7, awaiting review.
Feed and reading controls preview, PR #9, awaiting review.
Article speech preview, PR #11, awaiting review.
Standalone local RSS/Atom, optional FreshRSS and hide-empty-category setting. Issue #12, awaiting review.
Regular release: verified GitHub updates, always-visible read bookmarks and cleaner library pages. AI: ChatGPT Codex, #14.

Review build for #19: pure-black OLED theme, 15 popular RSS feeds with search/topic filtering and active-source add confirmation, and Show feed search setting. Source branch awaits Rick-selected review/main merge. Both builds and 54 unit tests per variant pass; actual phone tests pending.

FreshRSS and FlipRSS now have independent source tabs; Saved combines bookmarks from both, including read stories. Topics is removed, with category filters retained. The + icon is only on FreshRSS. Search always adds locally, and local feed menus offer URL view/copy and confirmed Add to FreshRSS without moving data.

Optional Mark as read on scroll defaults off and marks observed cards only after they pass the top. Search updates Feeder/Feedspot lists daily/on demand with offline cache and deduplication; website/feed URL discovery checks XML, alternate/RSS links and common paths. OLED and Search-disable settings remain.

AI: ChatGPT Codex, #21. Both builds/lint and 64 unit tests per debug/release variant pass; instrumentation compiled, not executed. Actual phone/installer/audio/real-account-write testing not run. Parser checks extracted 114 Feeder and 454 Feedspot public links; feed availability is publisher-controlled. Existing test signing identity retained for upgrades, production signing unconfigured.

Fixes repeated NBC News labels by matching Feedspot rows to their own headings. Incorrect old directory cache is replaced automatically, preserving subscriptions/Saved. Search now shows 20 results at a time with explicit Load more.

New Speech and voices from Settings or Voice in reader: installed engine/speaker choice, automatic engine-rated best quality, preview, reading speed and pitch. Online voices require explicit opt-in and may send text over the internet via the chosen Android engine. Install voice packs through Android settings and Refresh voices; audible quality depends on engine/device.

AI: ChatGPT Codex, #24/#25. Both builds/lint and 73 JVM tests per debug/release variant pass; instrumentation compiled, not run. Five publisher tests/actionlint pass. Actual phone/audio/naturalness/account-write testing not run. Existing test signer retained for updates; production signing unconfigured. No new service account/API key required for Android voice engine path.

Opening a story now loads longer public article text inside the reader when available, including Read aloud support. Feed text stays available during loading and on failure; manual retry and a persistent Load full articles setting are included. No login/paywall bypass. Verified on the TechCrunch story from Rick's screenshot: 144-character excerpt expands to 2,573 characters across nine text blocks.

FreshRSS and FlipRSS now have Mark all read at the bottom of their story lists. Settings → Confirm mark all read defaults on; turn it off to use either bulk-read button immediately for the current source/category, including unloaded stories. Saved/Search are excluded.

AI: ChatGPT Codex, #29/#30. 85 JVM tests per debug/release, both builds/lint (0 errors, 1 existing warning), five publisher tests and actionlint passed. Instrumentation compiled, not executed. Actual phone/audio/account-write tests not run. Existing test signer retained for upgrades; production signing unconfigured.
